guide.summary: Other customer workspaces will connect, so use a public connection with OAuth 2.0. Set the connection's capabilities to Read content only. Both read actions map to that single capability, which covers Retrieve a page (titles via filter_properties=title) and Retrieve page markdown. Test with one representative workspace and a shared test page before any rollout. Provider review and multi-workspace distribution rules are not established by these sources.

findings.title: Code-to-token exchange and refresh follow the authorization callback
findings.detail: After the callback returns a code, send it to the token endpoint. Refreshing returns a new access token and a new refresh token.

evidence.quote: To set up this step, retrieve the code from the redirect URI.
Next, send the code as part of a POST request to Notion’s token endpoint: https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/token .
Send the refresh_token provided from Step 4 as part of a POST request to Notion’s token endpoint: https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/token .

findings.title: Read content capability covers both read actions
findings.detail: Read content lets the connection retrieve existing pages. Missing capabilities return 403. The markdown endpoint requires read content on the target page.

evidence.quote: Read content : This capability gives a connection access to read existing content in a Notion workspace. For example, a connection with only this capability is able to call Retrieve
​ Errors The connection needs read content capabilities . Missing capabilities return 403 . A missing page or missing access returns 404 .
Requirements Your connection must have read content capabilities on the target page in order to call this endpoint. To update your connection’s capabilities, navigate to the Developer portal , select

findings.title: Do not enable write or comment capabilities
findings.detail: Update content and Insert content would allow prohibited writes, and Insert comments is outside the requested actions. Leave them disabled.

evidence.quote: Update content : This capability gives a connection permission to update existing content in a Notion workspace. For example, a connection with only this capability is able to call the
Insert content : This capability gives a connection permission to create new content in a Notion workspace. This capability does not give the connection access to read full objects. For
Insert comments : This capability gives the connection permission to insert comments in a page or in an existing discussion.

findings.title: Pages must be accessible to the connection before reads
findings.detail: A missing page or missing access returns 404. Reads therefore depend on pages the customer has made accessible to the connection.
findings.appliesWhen: Reading any customer page through the connection

evidence.quote: ​ Errors The connection needs read content capabilities . Missing capabilities return 403 . A missing page or missing access returns 404 .

steps.detail: In the Notion developer portal, open the public connection and enable Read content only. Leave Update content, Insert content and Insert comments disabled.
steps.doneWhen: Capability settings show Read content as the only enabled content capability.

steps.title: Implement authorization URL, callback and token exchange
steps.detail: Build the owner=user authorization link, a redirect handler that retrieves the code, and a POST to the token endpoint with Basic auth. Include refresh-token handling.
steps.doneWhen: Code paths exist for authorization URL, callback, code exchange and refresh.

evidence.quote: HTML < a href = "https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/authorize?owner=user&client_id=463558a3-725e-4f37-b6d3-0889894f68de&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fauth%2Fnotion%2Fcallback&response_type=code" > Add to Notion </ a >
Next, send the code as part of a POST request to Notion’s token endpoint: https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/token .

steps.title: Authorize a test workspace and share one test page
steps.detail: Use a developer-owned test workspace with a user account. Authorize the connection with owner=user, then share one test page with the connection. The code exchange must return an access token.
steps.doneWhen: Token exchange returns an access token and the shared test page is accessible.

evidence.quote: HTML < a href = "https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/authorize?owner=user&client_id=463558a3-725e-4f37-b6d3-0889894f68de&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fauth%2Fnotion%2Fcallback&response_type=code" > Add to Notion </ a >
To set up this step, retrieve the code from the redirect URI.

steps.title: Test reading page titles with a shared page (read-page-titles)
steps.detail: Call Retrieve a page with filter_properties=title. Expected response: a page object containing the title property for the shared test page. Boundary check: request an unshared page; expect 404. Read-only test; do not run any write request.
steps.doneWhen: Shared page returns its title property and the unshared page returns 404.

evidence.quote: ​ Errors The connection needs read content capabilities . Missing capabilities return 403 . A missing page or missing access returns 404 .

string[] Property names or IDs to include in each page's properties object. Other properties are left out. Repeat the parameter to pass more than one value, for example filter_properties=title&filter_properties=Status .
required The API version to use for this request. The latest version is 2026-03-11 .

steps.title: Test reading page content as markdown (read-page-content)
steps.detail: Call Retrieve page markdown for the shared test page. Expected response: markdown content of the page. Boundary check: inspect the connection's granted capabilities and confirm this test issues only GET requests; an unshared page returns 404.
steps.doneWhen: Markdown for the shared page is returned and the granted capabilities show Read content only.

evidence.quote: Set the markdown_version query parameter to v2 to get Notion-flavored Markdown instead. v2 is recommended. v1 is deprecated. It’s the default on current Notion-Versions. See Markdown versions .
Requirements Your connection must have read content capabilities on the target page in order to call this endpoint. To update your connection’s capabilities, navigate to the Developer portal , select
required The API version to use for this request. The latest version is 2026-03-11 .
